Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification-Mass Spectrometry) using streptavidin beads to pull down tagged FAM50A. Acquisition is DDA (Top Speed mode on Orbitrap Fusion). Quantification is performed via spectrum counting and SAINTexpress.

scope: For streptavidin based affinity purification, 10–20 × 10e6 293 T cells were lysed in low salt lysis buffer
Whole-cell extracts were incubated with 50 µl of Mag-Strep type 3 XT beads (IBA) for 30 min at 4 °C.
Beads with bound proteins were washed 5 times with IPP150 buffer
Bound proteins were digested with 0.5 µg of trypsin (sequencing grade, Roche) overnight at 37 °C.
Strepavidin capture identified a combined repertoire of 99 FAM50A interactors

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on material affinity-purified using streptavidin beads to capture FAM50A and its interactors from HEK-293T cell lysates.
